thread.title: Tim Cook comments on Trump meeting - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Yoel Minkoff
title: Tim Cook comments on Trump meeting - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Tim Cook has finally shed some light on last month's meeting with President Trump, stating the discussion focused on the importance of trade and how cooperation between two countries can boost the economy more than nations acting alone.
"It's true that not everyone has been advantaged from that - in either country - and we've got to work on that," the Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) CEO told Bloomberg TV. "But I felt that [Chinese] tariffs were not the right approach there, and I showed him some more analytical kinds of things to demonstrate why."
